package config

import (
	"fmt"
	"net"
	"net/url"
	"os"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
)

type Config struct {
	ListenAddress           string
	DatabaseURL             string
	InternalToken           string
	TeacherToken            string
	CatalogBaseURL          string
	CatalogInternalToken    string
	StudentBaseURL          string
	StudentInternalToken    string
	PlannerBaseURL          string
	PlannerInternalToken    string
	SandboxBaseURL          string
	SandboxInternalToken    string
	ValidationBaseURL       string
	ValidationInternalToken string
}

func Load() (Config, error) {
	return LoadFrom(os.Getenv)
}

func LoadFrom(get func(string) string) (Config, error) {
	if get == nil {
		return Config{}, fmt.Errorf("environment reader is required")
	}
	host := strings.TrimSpace(get("PRACTICE_RUNTIME_HOST"))
	if host == "" {
		host = "127.0.0.1"
	}
	port := strings.TrimSpace(get("PRACTICE_RUNTIME_PORT"))
	if port == "" {
		port = "8080"
	}
	portNumber, err := strconv.Atoi(port)
	if err != nil || portNumber < 1 || portNumber > 65535 {
		return Config{}, fmt.Errorf("PRACTICE_RUNTIME_PORT must be an integer from 1 through 65535")
	}
	if strings.Contains(host, ":") && net.ParseIP(host) == nil {
		return Config{}, fmt.Errorf("PRACTICE_RUNTIME_HOST must be a hostname or IP address without a port")
	}

	config := Config{ListenAddress: net.JoinHostPort(host, port)}
	settings := []struct {
		env    string
		target *string
	}{
		{"DATABASE_URL", &config.DatabaseURL},
		{"PRACTICE_RUNTIME_INTERNAL_TOKEN", &config.InternalToken},
		{"TEACHER_SERVICE_TOKEN", &config.TeacherToken},
		{"CATALOG_BASE_URL", &config.CatalogBaseURL},
		{"CATALOG_INTERNAL_TOKEN", &config.CatalogInternalToken},
		{"STUDENT_BASE_URL", &config.StudentBaseURL},
		{"PRACTICE_TASK_INTERNAL_TOKEN", &config.StudentInternalToken},
		{"LEARNING_PLANNER_BASE_URL", &config.PlannerBaseURL},
		{"PRACTICE_TASK_SERVICE_INTERNAL_TOKEN", &config.PlannerInternalToken},
		{"SANDBOX_BASE_URL", &config.SandboxBaseURL},
		{"SANDBOX_SERVICE_INTERNAL_TOKEN", &config.SandboxInternalToken},
		{"VALIDATION_ORCHESTRATOR_BASE_URL", &config.ValidationBaseURL},
		{"VALIDATION_ORCHESTRATOR_INTERNAL_TOKEN", &config.ValidationInternalToken},
	}
	for _, setting := range settings {
		value := strings.TrimSpace(get(setting.env))
		if value == "" {
			return Config{}, fmt.Errorf("%s is required", setting.env)
		}
		*setting.target = value
	}
	for _, setting := range []struct{ name, value string }{
		{"CATALOG_BASE_URL", config.CatalogBaseURL},
		{"STUDENT_BASE_URL", config.StudentBaseURL},
		{"LEARNING_PLANNER_BASE_URL", config.PlannerBaseURL},
		{"SANDBOX_BASE_URL", config.SandboxBaseURL},
		{"VALIDATION_ORCHESTRATOR_BASE_URL", config.ValidationBaseURL},
	} {
		parsed, parseErr := url.Parse(setting.value)
		if parseErr != nil || (parsed.Scheme != "http" && parsed.Scheme != "https") || parsed.Host == "" || parsed.User != nil || parsed.Fragment != "" {
			return Config{}, fmt.Errorf("%s must be an absolute HTTP(S) base URL without credentials or fragment", setting.name)
		}
	}
	return config, nil
}
